note: Russell County (KS) publishes no queryable zoning district layer. County zoning covers only unincorporated land and its GIS page lists only PDF county maps. The county's ArcGIS services (services2.arcgis.com/1ufANJSTSqs8jV0y: Parcel, Landuse, Township_Political, Russell_Voting_Wards, City_Limits) hold no zoning districts: Landuse is generalized existing/planned land use (LU_typ values like 'Comm', 'Resi', 'Crop'), not zoning. The City of Russell's zoning map and regulations are PDFs only; its Hub site has no zoning service found.
